ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Seatbelt Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the PUA/Recon tool Seatbelt via PE information of command line parameters

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Seatbelt\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Seatbelt\.exe" OR process_description = "Seatbelt" OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ DpapiMasterKeys.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ InterestingProcesses.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ InterestingFiles.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ CertificateThumbprints.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ChromiumBookmarks.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ChromiumHistory.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ChromiumPresence.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ CloudCredentials.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ CredEnum.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ CredGuard.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ FirefoxHistory.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ProcessCreationEvents.*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-group\\=misc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-group\\=remote.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-group\\=chromium.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-group\\=slack.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-group\\=system.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-group\\=user.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-group\\=all.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-outputfile\\=.*"))
